paite: "Nang mihing tapa, teklei pek la inla, na ma ah koih in, huai tung ah khopi Jerusalem khopi lim bawl in.
heading: Jerusalem Luhna Ding Ezekiel In Aching
english: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.

paite: Akim a um in kulh khohkhum inla, mual pawng bawlkhum in sepaih giahbukte bawlkhum inla, kulh suksiatnate akim in bawlkhum in.
english: Lay siege against it, build forts against it, and cast up a mound against it. Also set camps against it and plant battering rams against it all around.

paite: Sikpek la inla, nangmah leh khopi kikal ah sik baang ding in tung in; huai lam masuan inla, um in a-om ding a, nangmah in na um ding ahi. Hiai Israel inkote a dia etsak kholhna ahi ding.
english: Take for yourself an iron pan and set it for a wall of iron between you and the city. Then set your face toward it. It will be besieged, and you shall lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

paite: "Huan nang bel na veilam pang delh in lum inla, atung ah Israel inkote gitlouhna nga in; atung a na lup sung ani zah bang zel a agitlouhna uh na puak ding ahi.
english: “Moreover lie on your left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. According to the number of the days that you shall lie on it, you shall bear their iniquity.

paite: Agitlouhna kumte uh nang a ding a nite hi ding in lah ka septa ngal a, ni zathum-leh-sawmkua; huchibang in Israel inkote gitlouhna na po ding ahi.
english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

paite: Hiaite na khit hun chiang in na taklam pang delh in na lum leuleu ding a, Judah inkote gitlouhna na po ding, ni sawmli nang ding in ka sep hi; ni khat kum khat zel hi ding in.
english: “Again, when you have accomplished these, you shall lie on your right side, and shall bear the iniquity of the house of Judah. I have appointed forty days, each day for a year, to you.

paite: "Na ban khuh lou a zak in Jerusalem kiluhna lam nga inla, atungthu genkhia in.
english: You shall set your face toward the siege of Jerusalem, with your arm uncovered; and you shall prophesy against it.

paite: Ngai in, khauhual in ka hon hentom a, khopi kiluh sung nite abei masiah koilam ah leng na kihei ding ahi kei hi.
english: Behold, I put ropes on you, and you shall not turn yourself from one side to the other, until you have accomplished the days of your siege.

paite: "Buh, buhman, be, behiang, vai buhman la inla, bel khat ah koih in, huan tanghou in bawl in; na pang khat lam delh a na lup sung teng, ni zathum-le-sawmkua sung, huai na ne ding ahi.
english: “Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.

paite: Na an nek ding teh vek ding ahi, ni khat in shekel sawmnih ahi ding ahi; hunbi neitak in na ne ding ahi.
english: Your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day. From time to time you shall eat it.

paite: Tuite leng teh vek in na dawn ding ahi, hin khat seh guk suah seh khat ahi ding ahi, hunbi neitak in na dawn ding ahi.
english: You shall drink water by measure, the sixth part of a hin. From time to time you shall drink.

paite: Amitmuh un mihing ekgaw sing dia zang in na kang ding a, buhman tanghou nek in na ne ding," achi hi.
english: You shall eat it as barley cakes, and you shall bake it in their sight with dung that comes out of man.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N, "Hichibang an thanghuai Israel suante'n ka delhmangna ding namte lak ah ane ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “Even thus will the children of Israel eat their bread unclean, among the nations where I will drive them.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Eh! Toupa PATHIAN, Ngai dih, ka hinna hihnit ahi ngei kei a, ka tuailai a kipan tutan in leng, amah sih a si hiam, gamsa keih hiam ka ne ngei nai kei a, sa kihhuai ka kam ah alut ngei nai kei hi," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, my soul has not been polluted; for from my youth up even until now I have not eaten of that which dies of itself, or is torn of animals. No abominable meat has come into my mouth!”

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "En in, mihing ek sik in bawng ek ka hon pia, huaite zang in nek dingte na bawl ding hi," achi hi.
english: Then he said to me, “Behold, I have given you cow’s dung for man’s dung, and you shall prepare your bread on it.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah, "Mihing tapa, ngai dih, Jerusalem ah, an hinna bul ka hihse ding a, a-an uh teh vek in lauthawngtak in ane ding uh; tui leng teh vek in, lungkhamtak in adawn ding uhi.
english: Moreover he said to me, “Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem. They will eat bread by weight, and with fearfulness. They will drink water by measure, and in dismay;

paite: An leh tui tasam a, lungkhamtak a ki-entuah a, agitlouhna ua athammang khitna ding un."
english: that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
